name: Immediate Mode to Array Mode Optimization
definition: A technique to optimize rendering performance by replacing the immediate mode API (glBegin/glEnd with per-vertex calls) with array-based drawing commands (glDrawArrays/glDrawElements), reducing driver overhead and state changes.
summary: Immediate Mode to Array Mode Optimization replaces per-vertex calls with batched array commands and GPU-stored buffers to reduce driver overhead and improve rendering performance.
